words.text: In a few moments you will pass through these doors and be sorted. Smarten yourselves up. Follow me.
words.speaker: Professor McGonagall

words.text: My brothers said we'd have to wrestle a troll.
words.speaker: Ron

words.text: I've read all about the Sorting. It's only a hat... isn't it?
words.speaker: Hermione

words.text: Welcome! Welcome to a new year at Hogwarts.
words.speaker: Professor Dumbledore

words.text: When I call your name, you will come forward. I shall place the Sorting Hat on your head.
words.speaker: Professor McGonagall
